name: Your furniture
source: The furniture kit from the renter's earlier layout studios: the Fit check (three plans), Room to live (two plans) and the Apartment layout studio (Emerald Green 1211), plus the queen-bed and 55-inch TV study for Emerald Green 1211. No saved positions survived from those tools (they kept drags in the browser only), so sizes come from the tools' kit and positions are placed here with the studio's fit checks.

pieces.label: Queen bed

look.note: Upholstered grey fabric frame and headboard. The renter gave the colour and the upholstery; the exact shade is a mid grey.

pieces.note: Mattress 60 x 80 in on a 64 x 84 in frame with a 40 in headboard.
pieces.source: Fit check; Room to live uses a 62 x 84 in frame; the TV study uses a 60 x 80 in mattress.

pieces.label: Nightstand
pieces.note: The second nightstand; the Apartment layout studio kept it hidden by default.

look.note: IKEA Storklinta 4-drawer chest in black. The renter gave the colour.

pieces.label: Desk and chair

look.note: Brown wood desk with a chair and a monitor. The chair's look is a stand-in.

pieces.note: 60 x 24 in, 30 in tall, with a chair; adjustable from 36 to 84 in long.
pieces.source: Fit check; Room to live uses 72 x 24 in, the Apartment layout studio 54 x 24 in.

pieces.label: Futon, 3 seats

look.note: Black leather futon: a leather mattress seat and back on a frame. The renter gave black leather; the frame (black metal, no wooden arms) is a stand-in.

pieces.note: 80 x 36 in as a sofa; opens to about 80 x 56 in as a bed.
pieces.source: Fit check; Room to live checks an IKEA Nyhamn, 78.75 x 38.25 in.

pieces.label: Coffee table
pieces.note: Standard coffee table, 44 x 24 x 17 in.

pieces.label: 55-inch TV, bedroom

look.note: A 55-inch TV is a black panel; the exact casing is assumed.

pieces.note: Wall-mounted, 48.4 x 27.8 in, centre about 46 in off the floor. The Emerald Green study weighs an LG 55 in (48.1 in wide) against a 48 in (42.2 in wide).
pieces.source: Fit check; Room to live (Samsung 55 in spec); Emerald Green 1211 bedroom TV study.

pieces.label: 55-inch TV, living room

look.note: A 55-inch TV is a black panel; the exact casing is assumed.

pieces.note: Wall-mounted, 48.4 x 27.8 in, centre about 46 in off the floor.

pieces.label: Dining table, 4 seats

look.note: Brown wood table for four. The chairs' look is a stand-in.

pieces.note: 48 x 30 in rectangle with four chairs.

confirmed.note: The renter confirmed these are their own pieces, and on 2026-10-15 their colours and materials (each piece's `look`, where its basis is renter). A field listed in `assumed`, the TVs' casing and the chairs are stand-ins.
